summary: Vtable dispatch helper: initializes this via F_5FieldInit, then calls the vtable slot at offset 28 of the object pointed to by global dword_7CD8C0 with selector argument 13, and if a non-null object is returned, compares its name against this via ObjectNameComparison. Always returns 0. Mirror of ResourceCheckDispatch_9e80 with selector 13.

operations.description: Indirect call through vtable slot 28 of the object at global dword_7CD8C0, passing (dword_7CD8C0, 13); the slot behaves as an allocator/factory taking a selector.
Guard on the object returned by the vtable call being non-null.
If the returned object is non-null, call ObjectNameComparison(returnedObject, this) to compare object names.

unresolved: Type and contract of the object behind global dword_7CD8C0 and its vtable slot 28 (called with selector 13) are unknown.
Semantics of ObjectNameComparison and the meaning of selector 13 are unresolved; selector 12 is used by the sibling ResourceCheckDispatch_9e80.
